title: Jolly Spicy British Oat Casserole
description: A spicy and flaky British dish featuring ground oats, perfect for a lazy Sunday, and is FODMAP-friendly. This recipe uses a pressure cooker and is served in a tagliere.
instructions: Brown the ground beef in a pan over medium-high heat, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the chopped onion, carrot, and celery to the pan and cook until the vegetables are softened.
Stir in the tomato paste, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth to the pan and bring to a boil.
Add the ground oats to the pan and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a pressure cooker and cook on high pressure for 10 minutes.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick-release any remaining pressure.
Transfer the casserole to a tagliere and serve hot.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
